space.$description: Spacing. Prefer a relationship token (between-buttons, card-padding…) when one fits; otherwise use the scale. Gap sits between siblings, padding inside a container, margin outside an element.

100.$description: 4px. Tightest relationship: between titles (near), icon to text (near).

200.$description: 8px. Near relationships: body text, title to content, icon to text.

300.$description: 12px. Tighter default when a relationship must stay clear.

400.$description: 16px. The versatile standard distance — the default.

600.$description: 24px. Container padding, content to buttons, sections (near).

100.$description: -4px overlap. Only for intentional overlaps such as stacked avatars; never to fix layout.

200.$description: -8px overlap. Only for intentional overlaps such as stacked avatars; never to fix layout.

300.$description: -12px overlap. Only for intentional overlaps such as stacked avatars; never to fix layout.

400.$description: -16px overlap. Only for intentional overlaps such as stacked avatars; never to fix layout.

500.$description: -20px overlap. Only for intentional overlaps such as stacked avatars; never to fix layout.

600.$description: -24px overlap. Only for intentional overlaps such as stacked avatars; never to fix layout.

default.$description: Standard distance when no specific relationship applies.

default-near.$description: Tighter standard distance when the relationship must stay clear.

between-buttons.$description: Gap between buttons in a group.

content-to-buttons.$description: Gap between content and the buttons that act on it.

between-cards.$description: Gap between cards in a grid or list.

between-cards-near.$description: Gap between cards in a dense grid.

between-cards-far.$description: Gap between cards in a spacious layout.

icon-to-text.$description: Gap between an icon and its label.

icon-to-text-near.$description: Gap between an icon and its label in compact controls.

icon-to-text-far.$description: Gap between an icon and its label in large controls.

between-body-text-near.$description: Gap between closely related paragraphs or text blocks.

between-body-text-far.$description: Gap between separate paragraphs or text blocks.

title-to-content-near.$description: Gap between a title and its content in compact layouts.

title-to-content-far.$description: Gap between a title and its content.

between-titles-near.$description: Gap between a title and its subtitle.

container-padding.$description: Padding inside page containers, dialogs and large cards.

radius.$description: Corner radius. Apply the assigned token for the component (button, input, card-*); use the scale only for new patterns.

full.$description: Fully rounded: pills, avatars, badges, toggle tracks.

input.$description: Input controls: text fields, selects, chips. Brand-controlled (default 200).

card-md.$description: Medium cards, menus and popovers. Brand-controlled (default 200).

raised.$description: Resting cards that sit just above the page.

floating.$description: Menus, popovers, dropdowns — temporary layers anchored to a trigger.

overlay.$description: Drawers and sheets that cover part of the page.

normal.$description: Default transitions: expand, fade, small moves.
